snippet.title: God of War Laufey - Introducing Faye | PS5 Games
snippet.description:
God of War Laufey’s Narrative Director and Lead Writer share what we know about Faye from Kratos and Atreus’ journey in the Norse saga and give a taste of what awaits her in the afterlife of the gods. 

Wishlist God of War Laufey now at https://www.playstation.com/games/god-of-war-laufey.  

Launches on PlayStation 5 February 16, 2027.
